steps.text: The bass has one job: tell everyone what chord they're on. Roots on beat one anchor the harmony. Everything else is walking between anchors.
steps.title: THE JOB

steps.text: C2 on step 1 — the root, on the strongest beat. The ear forgives almost anything above a confident root.
steps.title: ROOT

steps.text: F2 on step 5 — we moved to the IV chord's root. Notice I walked C→D→E→F in my head; small steps between roots create pull.
steps.title: MOVE

steps.text: Your turn: walk it back. Put E2 (40) on step 9, D2 (38) on step 11, and C2 (36) on step 13. Descending into the root feels like landing.
steps.title: WALK DOWN

steps.text: Rules of thumb: chord tones on strong beats, passing notes on weak ones; never leap when a step will do; the octave is free energy — jump up an octave to restart a climb. The bass is felt more than heard, so keep it simple.
steps.title: RULES
